name: HashNeRF
aliases: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding
definition: A method using a hash encoding that maps inputs to a higher-dimensional space followed by a shallow neural network made of fully connected layers. It uses multiple hash tables for different resolutions and linear interpolation to embed features.
summary: HashNeRF is a NeRF optimization method that drastically reduces training time by replacing positional encoding with a trainable multiresolution hash encoding, enabling convergence in significantly fewer iterations.
